name: roamly-promo
description: Remotion project for the RoamlyFlow PA-student promotional video

scripts.render: npm run qr && npm run preflight && npm run srt && remotion render RoamlyPromo out/roamly-promo-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:vertical: npm run qr && npm run preflight && remotion render RoamlyPromoVertical out/roamly-promo-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:gif
